import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 as instructed
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_5/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_5/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on city
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, how='inner', on='city')

# Aggregate: group by city, count ride_id (ride_id is integer, city is string and primary key)
result = joined.groupby('city', as_index=False).agg({'ride_id': 'count'})

# Rename ride_id column to match target schema (count of ride_id)
result.rename(columns={'ride_id': 'ride_id'}, inplace=True)

# Write output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_5/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
